vessel_cargo_control_kalvora_star.csv, v.standard: Shipboard cargo-control system event log, one file per ship

fields.name: record_type
fields.notes: LOGIN, LOGOUT (console sessions); CMD (operator command); STATE (position feedback from the valve controller); ALARM (raised, cleared, acknowledged, inhibit on/off); LEVEL (tank gauging); REMOTE (remote-maintenance gateway attach/detach); EVENT; SURVEY

fields.name: station
fields.notes: where the record came from: CCR-1, CCR-2 (cargo control room consoles), RMT-GW (remote-maintenance gateway), VALVE-CTRL, TANK-GAUGING, ALARM-PANEL

fields.name: operator
fields.notes: rank for crew (C/O, 2/O, 3/O, PUMPMAN) or vendor account for remote sessions

fields.name: tag
fields.notes: valve, tank or alarm point: MV-* manifold valves, DROP-VALVE-<tank>, COT-<tank> cargo tanks 1P..6S

fields.name: text
fields.notes: LEVEL: volume in barrels; REMOTE: gateway session id, access level, ticket

vessel_cargo_control_kalvora_star.csv, v.cadence: tank gauging every 5 minutes during cargo operations and on the night of 13-14 September, hourly while alongside 11-21 September, every 6 hours otherwise; other records as they occur

vessel_cargo_control_remote_sessions.csv.standard: Vendor remote-maintenance gateway session log (all ships the vendor serves)

fields.name: session_id
fields.notes: also quoted in the ship logs' REMOTE records

fields.name: src_ip / src_asn
fields.notes: documentation address ranges; network of the connecting client

fields.name: target_system
fields.notes: name of the ship's cargo-control network on the vendor's portal (EXT-<SHIP>-CCS); ships whose network also appears elsewhere in the data have an entry with this system_id in gw_host_registry.json external_systems; empty for portal-only logins

fields.name: result
fields.notes: SUCCESS, FAILED: ..., DENIED: ..., or the administrative entry that disabled remote access

time_rule: Second-level time rule shared with the IT/security log family: records in different systems that describe the same action agree to within a few seconds. A status change that follows a command is stamped 1-3 s after the command.
joins: mmsi -> vessels.json and AIS; session_id links the gateway log and the ship logs
